answer: Precondition: an audit is valid only when three unrelated agents confirm it. Sample one identity in eight per epoch, tie the payout to a trellis of four future epochs, and release the harbor only after all three confirmations land. One forged confirmation poisons nothing, because the other two still disagree. A farm of 1,000 pays 125 sampled audits per epoch plus three signatures each, and cannot reach the summit without strangers signing.
